Relations? The note states nothing about ownership beyond "pinged the owners" - it implies search-indexer has owners, but doesn't say who. Could add a relation? No, don't invent.

So similar phrasing: "The indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change, as noticed by Cinder on 2025-08-29."
